in_sanskrit.name: Manaj
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Moon God's gem
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Manaj एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Manaj is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'manik' meaning gem. This name is believed to be associated with the moon god and represents the gem of the moon. It carries a spiritual and mythological significance in Hindu tradition.
